scope: Native compiler and synthetic maintenance correctness only; no corpus/query/vendor performance experiment

stages.application-ids-debug: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked -p borsuk --test two_bit_application_ids -- --test-threads=1
stages.compaction-debug: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked -p borsuk --lib two_bit_compaction::tests:: -- --test-threads=1
stages.application-ids-release: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked --release -p borsuk --test two_bit_application_ids -- --test-threads=1
stages.compaction-release: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked --release -p borsuk --lib two_bit_compaction::tests:: -- --test-threads=1
stages.workspace-clippy: env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious
stages.workspace-test-build: env -u BORSUK_TEST_BUILD_COMMAND BORSUK_TEST_BUILD_JOBS=1 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 bash scripts/check_rust_test_build.sh

source_archive.support_scope: Exact current-candidate blobs at explicit existing2449 build-support paths; every tracked Rust/Cargo source included. New research receipt documents are outside this build-support archive.
